"So we are building 00s style racing game with a camera behind a vehicle and a 3 lane road with bends and staff, race through different maps. The trick is multiple different obstacles on the road. Cows, traffic, pot holes and other different staff. The goal is to beat time on each map. There are bronze, silver, gold medals. Beating each medal gives you coins, which you can spend on upgrading your car or buying new cars. You can sell old cars you have, but you have to own at least one car. Also each race you gain xp points and there is an xp lvl system. Each new lvl asks for more xp to gain. The higher lvl you are, the more coins you earn (by special multiplier), the cooler cars you unlock to buy. Certain cars cannot be bought until you reach new lvl. The goal of the game is to unlock turbo car on lvl 50, upgrade it to the maximum and buy AI turbo driver for 1 mil coins. It's the only way to drive tracks fast enough to reach hidden AI medal time. Once you beat all tracks to AI MEDAL TIME, the game is completed. Although game looks retro, the cars it uses looks ultra modern. You start with slow ones. Like ford focus, Toyota roomy etc. end end up with racing cars like jaguar f type

---

Built **NEON MILE**, a playable retro-style arcade racing game. Run it from `index.html` or serve the project with a static web server.

It includes four themed routes, three-lane racing with bends and obstacles, steering and boost controls, medal times, coins and XP, driver levels, car purchases and sales, and five upgrade tiers. Progress saves in the browser. The level-50 Apex Turbo and AI Turbo Driver are part of the endgame.

**Checks:** `game.js` passes `node --check`; I also verified the garage and race screens in Chromium. I assumed a fictional roster inspired by the requested car types and set provisional track times and rewards. The sound toggle is present, but engine audio isn’t implemented yet.
